sources.title: How to create a neighbourhood plan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Current toolkit guidance covers area/forum designation, evidence, consultation, examination, referendum and adoption; stage status must be retained.

sources.title: How to write planning policies for a neighbourhood plan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The guidance distinguishes valid land-use planning policies from matters outside neighbourhood-plan scope; toolkit guidance is not itself local policy.

sources.title: Neighbourhood planning toolkits
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The current toolkit collection supports preparation but does not confer statutory weight on a draft or candidate site.

sources.title: After the neighbourhood plan is made: implementation, monitoring and review
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 guidance covers implementation, monitoring and review of made plans and notes older toolkit material may need checking against recent policy changes.

sources.title: Neighbourhood planning
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: A neighbourhood plan becomes part of the statutory development plan when brought into force; that weight applies only within its neighbourhood area.

sources.title: Adopted plans - Hadley Wood Neighbourhood Plan
sources.verified_claim: Hadley Wood Neighbourhood Plan was formally made in November 2023; parcel_30762 is not assumed to lie within its neighbourhood area.

sources.title: Kennington, Oval and Vauxhall neighbourhood plan
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states the KOV plan is made and carries full weight within the KOV neighbourhood area; parcel_61522 requires exact area matching.

sources.title: South Bank and Waterloo neighbourhood planning
sources.verified_claim: The forum was re-designated for the neighbourhood area; forum designation is not equivalent to a new or revised made plan and remains spatially specific.
